en.title: Neon Scatters – Sprinting Across the Star Chart
en.premise: In the sleepless city of Neo Bay, nighttime street skateboarding is the only way to rewrite the city’s order. The underdog boy Ren obtains the legendary route known as the Star Chart and sets his sights on the top. He weaves through gaps between skyscrapers, battling gravity in a high‑stakes race. The trail of light he carves cuts through the night’s darkness.

zh.title: Neon Scatters – 星图刻痕疾驰
zh.premise: 在不眠之城Neo Bay，夜晚的街头滑板是唯一能改写城市秩序的手段。落魄少年レン获得传说中的跑道『星图』，立志冲向巅峰。他在超高层大楼间穿梭，挑战重力，进行极限竞速。他所刻下的光轨划破夜色。
